label: Test Dress 0 (3D Scan Demo)
name: Test Dress 0
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, retopologized in AutoRemesher after welding coincident-duplicate vertices at fold seams in the source scan (see garment-capture-pipeline/weld_source.py) — fully watertight, no gaps.

label: Test Dress 1 (3D Scan Demo)
name: Test Dress 1
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, retopologized in AutoRemesher (already watertight straight out of RealityScan, no weld needed this time), with real diffuse texture baked from the dense source scan via garment-capture-pipeline/bake_texture.py + assemble_textured_glb.py.

label: Test Dress 2 (3D Scan Demo)
name: Test Dress 2
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, retopologized in AutoRemesher (already watertight straight out of RealityScan) and textured via garment-capture-pipeline/bake_texture.py + assemble_textured_glb.py. This scan's own export used a Z-up axis convention (unlike Test Dress 0/1's Y-up) and was rotated to match before import here.

label: Test Dress 3 (3D Scan Demo)
name: Test Dress 3
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, retopologized in AutoRemesher and textured via garment-capture-pipeline/bake_texture.py + assemble_textured_glb.py. Like Test Dress 2, this scan's own export used a Z-up axis convention (unlike Test Dress 0/1's Y-up); the same -90 deg rotation about X was applied to the baked mesh (empirically derived from comparing AutoRemesher's raw retopology output against the crop/align pass in RealityScan_Projects/TestDress3/TestDress3_Rotated.obj) before assembling the GLB.

label: Test Dress 4 (3D Scan Demo)
name: Test Dress 4
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, decimated directly from the dense textured scan (5.0M faces to 100k, keeping RealityScan's own UVs and texture at 4K) via garment-capture-pipeline/decimate_dense_textured.py. This scan's own export used a Z-up axis convention (unlike Test Dress 0/1's Y-up), so a -90 deg rotation about X was applied. The retopologize-and-rebake route used for Test Dress 0-3 was tried first and produced smeared texture and black blocks on the center-front placket, so it was replaced for this garment. model3d_rotationY set to 180 (confirmed 2026-09-23 via visual check) to face forward.
